label: Frozen [OPENING] Motion Purity
instructions: Does [OPENING] describe ongoing motion, actions unfolding over time, or camera movement instead of a frozen motionless t=0 frame?
trueDescription: [OPENING] describes characters walking, turning, pacing, gesturing over time, or camera pans/tracks/pushes.
falseDescription: [OPENING] describes strictly static poses, layout, and frozen t=0 framing.
escalationHint: Check [OPENING] for motion verbs or camera movement and rewrite as a motionless t=0 snapshot.

label: Frozen [OPENING] Audio Purity
instructions: Does [OPENING] describe any sound, noise, buzzing, humming, footsteps, foley, or spoken dialogue?
trueDescription: [OPENING] mentions audible sounds, noises, humming/buzzing, ambience, or speech.
falseDescription: [OPENING] is strictly visual with zero audio or sound cues.
escalationHint: Remove audio or sound cues from [OPENING] and relocate continuous ambience to [AESTHETIC] Audio.

label: Flowing [INTENT] (No Shot List)
instructions: Does [INTENT] read like a multi-step shot list or play-by-play choreography instead of one concise directorial sentence?
trueDescription: [INTENT] breaks down multiple sequential shots, camera cuts, or detailed action choreography.
falseDescription: [INTENT] is a concise high-level directorial goal sentence.
escalationHint: Condense [INTENT] into one flowing directorial sentence starting with 'Create ...'.

label: 180° Axis & Eyeline Parity
instructions: Does [EXECUTION] violate the 180-degree axis or flip a character's screen placement or facing direction compared to [LOGIC] and [OPENING] without a motivating camera arc or neutral bridge?
trueDescription: A character swaps screen sides (e.g., frame-right facing screen-left becomes frame-left facing screen-right) across a cut without an arcing camera move or neutral bridge.
falseDescription: Character screen placement and facing yaw stay consistent with [LOGIC] and [OPENING], or any axis cross is physically bridged.
escalationHint: Audit 180-degree axis parity and facing directions across cuts against [LOGIC] and [OPENING].

label: Clean S0 -> S1 Opening Handoff
instructions: Does Macro-State S1 contradict the camera framing, character posture, viewport layout, or hand grips locked in [OPENING]?
trueDescription: S1 starts from a conflicting shot scale, repositioned character, different posture, or altered hand grip compared to [OPENING].
falseDescription: S1 opens seamlessly from the exact frozen camera, posture, layout, and grips established in [OPENING].
escalationHint: Align S1's initial camera framing, viewport coordinates, posture, and hand grips with [OPENING].

label: Dialogue Subtitle Guard
instructions: Does the script contain spoken {dialogue} while [LOGIC] omits any subtitle policy (such as 'No subtitles appear on screen.')?
trueDescription: Spoken dialogue exists in [EXECUTION], and [LOGIC] does not mention subtitles or captions.
falseDescription: [LOGIC] states a clear subtitle policy (e.g., 'No subtitles appear on screen.') or no spoken dialogue is present.
escalationHint: Add an explicit subtitle policy (e.g., 'No subtitles appear on screen.') to [LOGIC].

label: Physical Wear Persistence
instructions: Once physical wear or environmental baggage appears (sweat, blood, mud, bruises, soaked clothes, exhaustion), does a later visible Macro-State drop it without it being cleaned or resolved?
trueDescription: Accumulated wear established earlier vanishes from visible [ACT] descriptions in later Macro-States without explanation.
falseDescription: Either no persistent physical wear is introduced, or accumulated wear is restated whenever visible.
escalationHint: Verify physical wear repetition across all visible Macro-States after wear is introduced.

label: Scene Brief Specs & Constraints
instructions: Does the script contradict any explicit format, line-count, shot-style, tone, or production constraint stated in the active Scene Brief?
trueDescription: The script violates a concrete requirement from the Scene Brief (e.g., wrong shot style, extra dialogue lines, conflicting setting or character rule).
falseDescription: The script follows all constraints and directorial notes in the active Scene Brief.
escalationHint: Reconcile script blocks and execution lines against the active Scene Brief specs and subtext.

label: Multimodal Reference Fidelity
instructions: Does the script contradict visual appearance, wardrobe, setting, audio identity, or continuation frame details shown in the attached Scene Brief reference media?
trueDescription: Character identity, setting details, wardrobe, or continuation opening state conflict with the attached image, video, audio, or document references.
falseDescription: The script aligns consistently with the attached Scene Brief reference media.
escalationHint: Cross-check character details, setting, and opening continuation handoff against the attached reference media.

label: Lookbook Bleed
instructions: Does Macro-State {{STATE_ID}} redundantly restate static wardrobe, film medium/lens stock, color palette, or room architecture already locked in [AESTHETIC]?
trueDescription: {{STATE_ID}} repeats static lookbook prose (outfit, film format/grain, color palette, or unchanging room decor) already declared in [AESTHETIC].
falseDescription: {{STATE_ID}} focuses on dynamic camera, blocking, action, dialogue, or foley without repeating static [AESTHETIC] prose.
escalationHint: Trim static [AESTHETIC] descriptions repeated inside {{STATE_ID}} (use declared shorthand tokens if referencing locations).

label: Single-Dimension Sub-State Law
instructions: Does any single '->'-separated Sub-State inside {{STATE_ID}} cram multiple unrelated dimensions together (such as mixing camera movement, physical acting, spoken dialogue, or sound effects inside one unit)?
trueDescription: One Sub-State in {{STATE_ID}} combines two or more distinct dimensions that should be split with '->' into separate [CAM], [ACT], {dialogue}, or <foley> Sub-States.
falseDescription: Every '->'-separated Sub-State in {{STATE_ID}} directs strictly one optical, spatial, physical, or acoustic dimension.
escalationHint: Split multi-dimension Sub-States in {{STATE_ID}} into separate '->'-chained single-dimension units.

label: Action Visibility vs. Active Camera
instructions: Does {{STATE_ID}} describe a visual [ACT] detail (such as eyes, pupils, subtle expression, or hidden hand action) that is physically hidden or unreadable from {{STATE_ID}}'s active [CAM] framing and angle?
trueDescription: {{STATE_ID}} describes facial or fine physical details that cannot be seen because the active camera is behind the subject, too wide, or aimed elsewhere.
falseDescription: Every [ACT] detail in {{STATE_ID}} is plausibly visible from its active [CAM] angle and shot scale.
escalationHint: Verify whether every [ACT] detail in {{STATE_ID}} is visible from its resolved camera framing, and adjust framing or action.

label: Explicit Hand Allocation
instructions: Does {{STATE_ID}} have a character grab, pick up, hold, open, or manipulate a distinct handheld prop without naming left hand, right hand, or both hands?
trueDescription: In {{STATE_ID}}, a character handles a distinct handheld object/prop without specifying left hand, right hand, or both hands.
falseDescription: Either {{STATE_ID}} has no handheld prop manipulation, or every handled prop explicitly names left, right, or both hands.
escalationHint: Specify exact hand allocation (left hand, right hand, or both hands) for handheld props in {{STATE_ID}}.

label: Room Tone Isolation (No Ambient Foley)
instructions: Does a <sound> foley tag in {{STATE_ID}} describe continuous background room tone or ambient bed noise (such as steady hum, constant rain, or ongoing traffic) instead of a discrete physical sound event?
trueDescription: A <...> tag in {{STATE_ID}} describes continuous ambient room tone that belongs in [AESTHETIC] Audio.
falseDescription: Every <...> foley tag in {{STATE_ID}} is a distinct, discrete physical impact, friction, or off-screen trigger sound.
escalationHint: Move continuous ambient room tone out of {{STATE_ID}}'s <foley> tag into [AESTHETIC] Audio.

label: Self-Contained Montage Anchoring
instructions: Does independent montage Macro-State {{STATE_ID}} omit its subject or setting/location cue (or rely on an unstated prior cut), leaving the shot visually unanchored?
trueDescription: {{STATE_ID}} lacks an explicit subject, location/LOC## cue, or self-contained plain [CAM] framing.
falseDescription: {{STATE_ID}} cleanly anchors its own framing, subject, and setting/location.
escalationHint: Ensure montage Macro-State {{STATE_ID}} explicitly establishes its own framing, subject, and setting (or declared LOC## token).
